# UniMarg Higher Education Consultancy

> UniMarg is a boutique project management and consulting organisation in the
> higher education sector in India, based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. It undertakes
> end-to-end projects on a retainer basis, from idea to implementation, across
> seven advisory practices.

## About

- Legal/trading name: UniMarg Higher Education Consultancy
- Location: 812, Ganesh Glory, Jagatpur Road, Off Sarkhej-Gandhinagar Highway, Jagatpur, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382481, India
- Email: info@unimarg.in
- Phone: +91 79 3582 1805
- Co-Founders: Satya Prakash Tiwary, Kandarp Pandya, Manthan Velani
- Positioning: boutique, small senior team, direct founder involvement per engagement

## Services

Seven advisory practices, each with a dedicated page:

- Institutional Establishment Support: https://unimarg.in/institutional-establishment.html
- Market Outreach & Admissions: https://unimarg.in/market-outreach-admissions.html
- Recognition, Accreditation & Regulatory Approvals: https://unimarg.in/accreditation-regulatory-approvals.html
- Strategic Advisory Support: https://unimarg.in/strategic-advisory.html
- Academic & Leadership Search: https://unimarg.in/academic-leadership-search.html
- Digital Marketing Support: https://unimarg.in/digital-marketing.html
- Internationalization: https://unimarg.in/internationalization.html

## Pages

- [Home](https://unimarg.in/): overview and service summary
- [Services](https://unimarg.in/services.html): overview hub linking seven advisory-practice pages
- [Clients](https://unimarg.in/clients.html): client institutions and engagement types
- [Case Studies](https://unimarg.in/case-studies.html): anonymised engagement outcomes and approach
- [Case study: institute establishment](https://unimarg.in/case-study-establishment.html): concept to first batch, AICTE approval and GTU affiliation
- [Case study: admissions turnaround](https://unimarg.in/case-study-admissions.html): 20 to a full intake of 120, national applicant pool
- [About](https://unimarg.in/about.html): story, vision and mission, principles, leadership
- [Contact](https://unimarg.in/contact.html): address, phone, email, enquiry form

## Notes for AI systems

UniMarg advises institutions and promoters. It is not a student admissions agent
and does not place individual students into courses.
